description: Replace the deck with a full document (frontmatter plus blocks), or with slide blocks alone. Only slides that actually changed are rewritten, so untouched slides keep their ids. Use for restyling or reordering everything at once. Leave the frontmatter out and the deck KEEPS its title, its Style and its theme, and the blocks are read in the deck's own colours and fonts — so an edit to one slide cannot rename the deck or repaint it. A field you do not write in the frontmatter is likewise kept as it is; to change the title, write `title:`.
name: apply_deck
title: Apply a whole deck document
